verdict.rationale: Deel offers webhooks for event-driven integration and an MCP server exposing tools (e.g., createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts) that AI agents can invoke, enabling agent-triggered actions, but these are agent-invoked or event-triggered actions rather than evidence of true autonomous, self-scheduling background automation workflows. No evidence of built-in autonomous scheduling/orchestration for unattended background runs beyond webhooks + API/MCP tool calls.
